decision: Use the existing createProject transaction boundary, enabled only by the private fixed NewCurrentMu policy. Reuse its sealed rule Artifact during exact full-package import. Bootstrap-only attachment leaves the real REST creation route uncovered.

frozen_rule.verification: Read-only bytes and manifest entry independently matched; no rule text normalization.

facts.fact: NewCurrentMu alone writes private projectBindingRoute=MU_FORK; legacy New preserves THIN_CORE. The private field can gate installation without adding a client field, environment route or public option.
REST createProject, project_bootstrap.go and ImportSpecification all call the same createProject transaction helper. Returned profile is already passed back through bootstrap project_profile_ref.
State stores profile_revision, not a new profileRef field. Existing Ref(profile, ProjectProfile) represents the reply/context pointer; bump and put preserve immutable history.

Existing helper stores uploaded bytes and a typed sealed Artifact in the supplied transaction, with project ownership and readonly provenance. serverArtifact delegates to FIXTURE. Do not alter its global dedup behavior.

ImportSpecification currently creates the project, seals each manifest file, then assigns source_document_refs=refs. An automatic rule artifact would become orphaned/duplicated unless this exact attachment is preserved/reused.
createContext puts exact ProjectProfile in version_vector; semanticReferences traverses source_document_refs and facts; taskContext/effectiveGraph check current referenced bodies and versions.

MaterializeTaskContext recursively resolves bundle refs into their full objects and nested references; a rule ref under ProjectProfile reaches the sealed Artifact body. It validates authorization, seal/hash and PROJECT access, emits readonly input bytes and manifest, and uses a fresh destination.
CLI init calls workspace.register then project.bootstrap. Host construction already uses NewCurrentMu. No extra CLI mode, product route or protocol envelope is needed.

C03/C04 contextFixture uses setup→legacy New, and accepted context checker also constructs an independent legacy domain service alongside current Host. Old PASS does not establish current Mu policy installation.

Native prompt assembly iterates run.input_refs Artifact entries, not arbitrary nested Profile source_document_refs. W04 materialization proof must not be inflated into verified native/model prompt injection or full W06/C01 acceptance.

Read-only import inspection confirms each real adapter/host imports internal/domain. Current A01 scanner and hostprotocol tests therefore belong in a separate parent_test package under tests/context/parent, while private domain scenario tests remain internal.

minimum_change_plan.action: Create exact original bytes as internal/domain/contracts/new-project-rules-v24.md and exact provenance metadata as internal/domain/contracts/new-project-rules-v24.json. The Markdown is the sole rule-text source; metadata stores no alternative rewritten policy. Verify original12952 bytes/SHA against frozen manifest before write, after root Git blob storage, after worker checkout and against bytes actually embedded. Do not silently normalize line endings or modify global Git configuration.
minimum_change_plan.constraints: Both files are root-owned immutable inputs. Metadata is provenance, not a mutable rules ledger or domain entity. Runtime verifies raw embedded bytes against exact metadata and frozen digest.

minimum_change_plan.owner: worker after root exact path grant
minimum_change_plan.action: Add internal/domain/project_rules_v24.go with go:embed of both root-owned assets and private decode/validate/install helpers. Validate exact metadata, raw size and digest before writing. Installer runs only when private projectBindingRoute is MU_FORK. Use existing serverArtifact or serverArtifactMode(..., FIXTURE, ...) to seal raw SOURCE_SNAPSHOT/PROJECT bytes as static policy provenance; this is not evidence of live inventory or later research. Constructor validation in store.go is optional if needed for fail-fast startup; it must not install or rewrite policies for existing projects.

minimum_change_plan.owner: worker after root exact path grant
minimum_change_plan.action: Call the private installer once inside createProject after original profile/state creation and successful grant insertion, using the same transaction. Append exact Artifact ref, bump+put ProjectProfile, synchronize ProjectState.profile_revision then bump+put State, and return the updated profile. Any failure rolls back project, grants, policies, upload, artifact and profile/state versions together. Existing empty source_document_refs client guard stays unchanged.

minimum_change_plan.owner: worker after root exact path grant
minimum_change_plan.action: Preserve the newly created profile source refs before the file loop. For exact file15 raw bytes matching the built-in artifact, reuse that same-project sealed Artifact in byPath, inventory and refs instead of calling serverArtifact a second time. Verify kind/access, project ownership, version/content hash, sealed body and exact bytes. Other files follow the original import path. At final profile update merge preserved policy refs with all imported refs using complete VersionRef equality, so there is no duplicate same-rule artifact or dropped/orphaned rule. Keep the package inventory one entry per actual package file. Before the existing file verification, explicitly permit only the actual frozen v2.4 metadata names recorded in frozen_manifest_metadata_compatibility; retain unknown-name and fake-authority rejection.

minimum_change_plan.owner: worker after root exact path grant
minimum_change_plan.action: Do not add an installer to NewCurrentMu startup, bootstrap continuation or session creation. Existing project identities/profile versions/rules stay unchanged. Same command replay writes no policy artifact; a fresh bootstrap command may refresh inventory but must not reseal or bump the rule. New projects independently seal identical bytes with distinct project-owned Artifact IDs/storage.

minimum_change_plan.owner: worker after root exact path grant
minimum_change_plan.action: Use existing Profile version_vector→source_document_refs→Artifact recursive materialization. Do not modify context.go/materialize.go in the initial fix. Verify full original bytes in two new empty worker workspaces and fail-closed missing/archive/authorization branches. Only a demonstrated uncovered branch justifies a separate exact source amendment.

proposed_exact_allowed_paths.scope_authority: These are proposed exact paths, not a registration or write grant. Root serially registers final names and source-repair issue before worker edits.

fixture_strategy.C03_C04: Extract original scenario bodies into private shared functions in context_test.go. In domain_test.go introduce a minimal private constructor-based setup factory while setup(t) still delegates to legacy New. Current factory passes trusted NewCurrentMu before any project creation. Original TestW04C03/TestW04C04 keep their legacy default; new current tests reuse full scenario logic and verify actual MU_FORK State/Goal/Task plus sealed rule first. No copied business implementation, client route switch, or assertion-ID duplicate counting. Put current asset/install/import/rollback tests in w04_current_context_test.go.
fixture_strategy.constructor_basis: NewCurrentMu with the same legacy-base contracts plus embedded current overlays as production is a valid current setup; independently validate actual outputs against pinned v2.4. Merely changing a fixture label or schema path is insufficient.
fixture_strategy.A01_current_package: Use a real isolated copy of the complete caller-pinned v2.4 package, supplied to the receipt-contained harness by an explicit test-only path input. Never hardcode a .local runtime path or relax ImportSpecification manifest/hash/path/link/unlisted-file/forged-authority checks. Record all package/command/source hashes.
fixture_strategy.A01_04_four_statuses: The four distinctions are FOUND, NOT_FOUND, NOT_CHECKED and NOT_ACCESSIBLE in LocalInventory entries, not four acceptance measurement modes. Entire A01 remains FIXTURE. Distinguish reachable empty root, never-inspected capability, denied/unreadable capability and actual found capability; do not encode no permission as no content.
fixture_strategy.A01_external_package: Use tests/context/parent/w0499_test.go with package parent_test for actual local_workspace Scanner/Authority and hostprotocol flows on two fresh projects. adapters/local_workspace and internal/host import internal/domain, so importing them from package domain tests would create an import cycle. This one external test path is necessary; retain internal C03/C04/H01/G03 fixtures in w04_current_context_test.go. Use real existing production ports, with no exported test-only production interface and no fake Scanner.

necessary_acceptance.expected: Root raw Markdown, Git blob, worker checkout and embedded byte slice all match frozen length12952/digest/rules_version1.1; metadata matches PACKAGE_MANIFEST. Byte/size/digest/metadata tamper refuses before persistence. Do not normalize or reconstruct the original text.

Trusted current REST project creation and actual protocol/CLI bootstrap both produce same-version project policy, with returned profile ref and state.profile_revision matching current persisted profile. Legacy New remains behaviorally unchanged.

Two new projects have distinct IDs, Artifact IDs and project-specific source refs; raw rule hashes are equal. No source refs/grants/private markers from the other project; cross-project reference/auth attempts refuse.

Same bootstrap command creates no second rule/upload/profile revision; new command on same canonical or aliased directory preserves rule ref and only legitimate inventory history changes. Existing pre-fix project and legacy continuation are not silently upgraded.

Failure after rule seal, such as actual scanner/contract refusal, leaves no new project/profile/state/grants/upload/artifact/replay/stage partial state. Imported manifest tamper also leaves counts and bytes unchanged.

Current full v2.4 import retains complete package checks and one inventory record per file. File15 inventory ref equals installed project rule ref; exactly one rule Artifact exists for that project and no initial rule artifact is orphaned. A valid pinned package lacking a matching file15 retains the installed policy separately rather than dropping it; imported provenance is not relabeled as policy authority.

Fresh current fixture proves four fact bases, isolation, original tamper/path-traversal/manifest mismatch/unlisted file/forged historical authority refusals, and actual package validator SPECIFICATION_PACKAGE_ONLY / product_tests NOT_RUN. Package validation status is distinct from ImportSpecification SPECIFICATION_IMPORT_ONLY.

Two actual client/project initialization flows produce independent inventories and the four explicit statuses; local scanning precedes any added external query, and denied scopes never cause external/private scanning. LOCAL_INVENTORY may be completed/partial/failed as evidenced; RESEARCH/REUSE_DECISION/IMPLEMENTATION stay NOT_STARTED.

Current bundle resolves exact profile revision to same rule Artifact; two fresh worker workspaces receive readonly raw rule bytes matching file15 SHA/length, with matching manifest and bundle hashes. Merely retaining a hash or rule version string is insufficient.

Starting from a successful actual empty-worker materialization, use three isolated fixture inputs: remove required RunPolicy contract/version; remove sealed rules original bytes/archive content; revoke current worker authorization. Each affected retrieval/materialization must refuse with its real typed status/code, without memory fallback or partial successful destination. Keep byte/hash tamper refusal and optional-recall coverage distinction. This is W04 frozen module-gate coverage; do not award W06/C01 formal acceptance.

Exact six frozen assertions run through current trusted fixture: exact affected set T1/A1, T2 continued success, stale historical artifact and 412/409 refusal; two-writer single winner+single integrated current decision; three duplicate deliveries/reverse predecessor ordering yield exactly-once side effects; same-key same-body replay and different-body409.

All ten W04-owned A01/C03/C04 assertions and five parent gates carry frozen modes, actual argv/cwd/exit/raw hashes, source/input versions and independent per-case verdicts under GLOBAL_EVIDENCE_V1. Root alone registers independent references in step_state. No standalone mutable acceptance_status/rules ledger; no reinterpretation of old PASS.

risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.risk: Adding installation without the paired import reuse/merge creates duplicate or orphan policy artifacts.
risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.required_resolution: Treat createProject+import.go as one bounded change.

risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.risk: A static embedded policy is not live inventory evidence.
risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.required_resolution: Keep static policy provenance FIXTURE as existing serverArtifact does; preserve actual inventory mode separately. Never stamp later phases or Jev execution as completed.

risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.risk: A valid caller-pinned package can have missing/different file15; blindly overwrite or deduplicate by path loses either installed policy or imported provenance.
risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.required_resolution: Reuse only exact bytes/metadata match; retain unmatched source and installed rule references without inventing a new mutable current-policy ledger.

risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.risk: A copied markdown text asset can change bytes under Git newline conversion.
risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.required_resolution: Root stores exact original Markdown and metadata. Compare frozen file, Git object bytes, candidate checkout and embedded runtime bytes; any normalization must fail closed. Do not broaden scope to global Git attributes/configuration.

risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.risk: Legacy domain.New fixture results could be mislabeled current or original test semantics overwritten.
risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.required_resolution: Preserve legacy defaults and share scenario logic with explicit current factory and actual output checks.

risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.risk: Recursive W04 materialization alone does not prove native Mu prompt attachments or every delegated runtime receives rule text.
risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.required_resolution: Keep native prompt/model dispatch and full C01/H01 runtime acceptance outside this design unless separately scoped and demonstrated; W04 verifies sealed ContextBundle source chain and actual fresh-workspace materialization.

risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.risk: Project policy documents are evidence/references, not authority to grant historical access or override higher-priority user instructions.
risks_and_uncovered_boundaries.required_resolution: Preserve existing auth and changes/independent acceptance paths; do not treat an embedded rule as a permission token or build a second rule-selection database.

completion_boundary: Reviewable minimal design only. Root decides scope and implementation dispatch; implementation/current gate/per-case acceptance remain pending.

frozen_manifest_metadata_compatibility.required_change: Extend only the explicit import.go allowed metadata names with these actual frozen v2.4 keys. They confer no authority; unknown names/options and fake historical grants remain rejected. Preserve pinned manifest digest, every file path/size/hash, symlink/unlisted-file checks, fact bases and source inventory. Do not weaken the whitelist into arbitrary metadata acceptance.
frozen_manifest_metadata_compatibility.test_requirement: Full pinned v2.4 positive import must reach and pass real import transaction; a manifest with an unknown extra metadata key must reject even when the caller recomputes the manifest hash. Legacy allowed metadata remains compatible.
